basic_token_count:
def solution(text: str) -> int:
    return len(text.split())
basic_mask_digits:
def solution(text: str) -> str:
    return ''.join('*' if ch in '0123456789' else ch for ch in text)
basic_unique_keep_order:
def solution(items: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return list(dict.fromkeys(items))
applied_window_max:
def solution(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    window = sum(nums[:k])
    best = window
    for i in range(k, len(nums)):
        window += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
        best = max(best, window)
    return best
